newsitem.title: USA: FCC chief says AT&T-SBC deal would raise questions.
newsitem.headline: FCC chief says AT&T-SBC deal would raise questions.

text.p: Federal Communications Commission Chairman Reed Hundt said Tuesday a merger of AT&T Corp and SBC Communications Inc would raise questions over whether the new company would be too large.
But he said he did not know the answer and declined to comment specifically on whether such a concern would in fact be too big for the public interest.
"Obviously, it calls the following question into mind, which is: Where's the line?" Hundt told a press conference.
AT&T is reported by the Wall Street Journal to be in merger talks with regional Baby Bell SBC. Any deal could be worth at least $50 billion, according to the paper.
